rootCauseAddressed: Tier 4 deployed browser journey remained on the Operator Launchpad gate because access-gate form submission did not establish an operator or owner session before protected-route navigation. Production gates now use explicit POST route handlers with redirect and Set-Cookie behavior.
changeSummary: Added explicit POST route handlers for operator, owner, crew, and special-guest production access gates.
Changed gate forms to standard method=post submissions to the new API handlers.
Preserved owner/master universal authority through operator, crew, and special-guest gates with safe next-target handling.
Preserved role-specific password boundaries and existing owner/operator route authorization rules.
Retained prior owner-universal cookie acceptance across launchpad, operator packet, middleware, crew capability actions, event-role actions, and logout cleanup.
localHttpProof: POST /api/production-access/operator with operator password returned 303, set wpl_operator_access, and allowed GET /admin/testing/tier4-manual-event to return 200.
POST /api/production-access/operator with owner/master password returned 303, set wpl_owner_access, and allowed GET /admin/testing/tier4-manual-event to return 200.
validationNotClaimed: Tier 4 Playwright browser proof: attempted, but this container blocked Chromium navigation with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR.
Full Tier 4 live-provider proof: requires user's local encrypted .env.local, deployed Cloudflare env, and live provider credentials.
